key.name: mark-read-on-open
key.description: Mark an article as read as soon as it is shown.

key.name: keep-read
key.description: How long read articles are kept. Unread and starred articles are always kept.

key.name: muted-words
key.description: Words, phrases or patterns that mute an article. Entries start with text:, word: or regex: to choose how they match.

key.name: muted-action
key.description: Hide muted articles, or dim them and reveal them when selected.

key.name: saved-limit-mb
key.description: Megabytes kept for articles saved for later. The oldest ones are removed when the limit is reached.

key.name: last-seen
key.description: When the News window was last in front, as a Unix time. Articles fetched later count as new on the dock icon.
